Lina (PM): dropping a quick prototype for the playground streaming chat controls + prompt library. top items: stop/regenerate labels, token counter placement, keyboard flow in prompt tray. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. pls review. Evan (Designer): compact composer looks cleaner. small a11y nit: replace icon-only buttons with full accessible labels. tooltips alone aren’t sufficient for SR users. ensure 44px tap targets. Sam (Frontend): noted. current stream region is aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" which causes repeated reannouncements on each chunk. recommend aria-atomic="false" and role="status" so partial updates aren't read in full. Maya (Eng): stopping is non-destructive (we keep generated text). language matters. do we want 'Stop generation', 'Interrupt', or 'Pause'? Darla (Content): prefer plain verbs. 'Stop generation' and 'Regenerate response' are clear. tooltip can say what happens after stopping. Lina (PM): keyboard shortcuts: Esc is risky. propose Cmd/Ctrl+. to stop, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to regenerate. open to feedback. Sam (Frontend): Cmd/Ctrl+. ok. will expose shortcuts in tooltips and in an accessibility help panel. will also add visible focus outlines to the control group. a11y-bot: checklist: accessible names, role=status for stream, aria-atomic=false, focus order, skip link for prompt library, contrast >= 4.5:1, 44px targets. Evan (Designer): token counter: desktop inline at right of composer row; mobile collapse into an expander in the status row. visual idea: show a small transient +N token bubble per chunk then merge into total to reduce jitter. make token visuals semantic color, not success/error colors. Maya (Eng): backend note: streaming token counts are estimates until finalization. we'll provide estimated_tokens in-stream and final tokens on completion. frontend should debounce updates (~200ms) to avoid layout thrash. Sam (Frontend): implementation detail: hide the token-delta animation from SRs (aria-hidden) and announce only the consolidated total when final. snippet:
Streaming
. Darla (Content): microcopy proposals: Stop button: 'Stop generation' (tooltip: 'Stops the current response; generated text remains'). Regenerate: 'Regenerate response' (tooltip: 'Send the same prompt again'). Token label: 'Tokens: 123' with optional cost tooltip for paid plans. Evan (Designer): prompt library: use a slide-over tray (not modal) with an announced count like 'Prompt library, 12 items'. provide a skip link so keyboard users can jump to the composer. Lina (PM): decisions: use 'Stop generation' + 'Regenerate response'; shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+. to stop, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to regenerate; prompt tray = slide-over with skip link and announced item count; token counter = desktop inline, mobile collapsed, with transient delta animation. Sam (Frontend): i'll PR aria changes, focus styles, and shortcut wiring. Maya (Eng): i'll add estimated_tokens + final tokens to streaming payload and debounce updates. Evan (Designer): i'll update figma frames for desktop/mobile and prototype the token-delta motion. Darla (Content): i'll finalize microcopy and tooltips. a11y-bot: added checklist to thread. Lina (PM): thanks team. sync Monday 10am for sign-off. :thumbsup:
